question: open-a3
unit: NZD/m² of roof area, GST exclusive

band.unit: NZD/m² of roof area, GST exclusive
band.basis: QV butyl membrane rates for 1 mm black through 1.5 mm grey, laid on plywood or concrete. At 1,200 m² this indicates $120,000–$182,400, with a Wellington 1.5 mm black centre of $158,400. This is the membrane cost only, not the net premium or saving against a specified Coloursteel alternative. Low confidence reflects the unspecified membrane selection and the assumption of a suitable existing deck.

band.unit: NZD/m² of roof area, GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of the three distinct components. Assumes a continuous plywood deck can be installed over existing purlins without structural changes, then covered with 1.5 mm black butyl rubber membrane. Prices the membrane roof alone; no Coloursteel option credit or deduction is included. For 1,200 m², the indicative extension is $256,800–$283,200, with a Christchurch-centred estimate of $266,400. Existing roof removal or disposal, flashings, gutters, drainage, structural changes, and insulation or ceiling work are excluded.

band.unit: NZD/m² of roof area, GST exclusive
band.basis: Indicative cost impact of the membrane option less the avoided new Coloursteel roof option, using conservative cross-region rate bounds: (146−64) to (152−61) = NZD 82–91/m², centre about NZD 87/m². For 1,200 m², this is approximately NZD 98,400–109,200, centre NZD 104,400. Assumes 1.5 mm butyl membrane on an existing suitable solid substrate; existing roof removal and disposal, structural changes, insulation or ceiling work, flashings, gutters, and drainage are excluded. Rates are unreviewed QV CostBuilder rows. Low confidence reflects the unspecified membrane build-up and the proxy nature of the Coloursteel rate. This is a working estimate, not a certified price.
